chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muthanna ibn Al-Walid Al-Hannat, from Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a woman who left behind a husband and two parents. He said: 'For the husband is half, and for the mother is one-third, and for the father is one-sixth.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a husband, mother, and father when a woman dies?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the distribution of an estate when a deceased woman leaves behind a husband and both parents, establishing the husband's share as one-half, the mother's as one-third, and the father's as one-sixth. This specific configuration highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle that the mother's share increases to one-third when she is accompanied by the father, distinguishing it from cases where only one parent survives. The hadith serves as a practical application of the general inheritance rules found in Surah An-Nisa, demonstrating how specific heirs interact to determine final portions.
